game.title: Far Cry 3
game.blurb: Open-world first-person shooter in which Jason Brody fights pirates across a tropical island chain, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2012-11-28. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Escaping the pirates, joining the Rakyat, rescuing friends and reaching the South Island. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Outposts and Radio Towers
chapters.summary: Liberating outposts, quietly or not, and activating radio towers.

chapters.title: Side Quests and Poker
chapters.summary: Path of the Hunter, Supply Drop, WANTED Dead, Trials of the Rakyat, poker winnings and the lost Hollywood star.

chapters.title: Hunting, Crafting and Skills
chapters.summary: Hunting predators and rare animals, crafting upgrades and syringes, tattoos and the shop.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Relics, Letters of the Lost, memory cards and Survival Guide entries.

chapters.title: Combat and Stunts
chapters.summary: Explosions, takedowns from above, the bow, the camera, rocks, and long falls and dives.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; it links Gameplay, Table of Contents and Walkthrough subpages, but none exist (a prefix search found no subpages). farcry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 237 linked pages, including "Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon" and several DLC pack pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Far Cry® 3". None of the 44 Steam achievements are hidden; the 12 story ones were placed in the main story chapter by name, since their descriptions are visible but spoilery. No multiplayer or co-op achievements are in the Steam list, although StrategyWiki and RAWG mention multiplayer. Steam unlock rates look low (only 20% have "First Blood"), possibly because many owners never launch the game through Steam; that is a guess.
